_source: DeliveryFeeCalculatorService (app.order.* defaults and the app_config keys that override them), V34__fixed_categories_platform_fee.sql, and VendorDeliveryThresholdService.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_FALLBACK.
_why: The estimator on the public site runs the SAME arithmetic the backend runs, rather than an approximation of it. If a number here stops matching the service, the site starts lying about what an order costs — so each value names the exact constant it mirrors.
_freeRangeKm: app.order.free-range-km, overridable by app_config['delivery.free_range_km']. The base fee covers everything inside this.
_petrolPriceInrPerL: app.order.default-petrol-price. In production this is the city's fuel price for the day, updated by an admin; this is the fallback the service uses when there is no entry.
_defaultFreeDeliveryThresholdInr: VendorDeliveryThresholdService.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_FALLBACK. Each vendor sets their own per category; this is what applies until they do.
_categories: The six permanent categories and their platform_fee_percent: the five from V34, plus Toys — whose fee is set in the admin console (see categories.json _toysFee).
_rider: SplitPayoutService.driverAmount: the rider is paid the order's whole delivery_fee — base plus any extra-km charge — passed straight through, whichever side funded it. delivery.base_payout_inr / payout_per_km_inr / min_payout_inr (20 / 5 / 30) are only a fallback for an order with no delivery fee on it, so the site never quotes them.
_maxDistanceKm: Checkout refuses an order beyond 20 km (admin-tunable), the same ceiling as the customer's search radius, so discovery and ordering cannot disagree.
_absorbCeilingPercent: ProfitSimulatorService.ABSORB_CEILING_PCT: a free-delivery order should give away no more than this share in platform fee plus delivery base. The recommended minimum threshold is ceil(base / (ceiling − fee%)).
_marginFloorPercent: ProfitSimulatorService.MARGIN_FLOOR_PCT: below this gross margin an order is flagged as thin.
